# tools/ index

**Generated by `node tools/m59-index.mjs`. Do not edit by hand.**

743 tools, 730 tests. 52 tool(s) have no header comment.

Read this before writing a new tool. `node tools/m59-index.mjs --find <word>`
searches it. If what you need is here, use it; if it is nearly here, extend it.
